skill.summary: Local thumbnail generator for videos. Picks the best candidate frames using brightness, sharpness, and scene-change scores, composes professional thumbnails...

latestVersion.changelog: v0.2.0 — adds scripts/score_thumbnail.py, a deterministic local click-likelihood scorer that ranks one or more finished thumbnails on six visual metrics (punch, focal_pop, color_punch, text_band, brightness, edge_density) and explains which metric drove each pairwise comparison. Pure Pillow + stdlib, no ML, no remote calls. Bug fixes: compose_thumbnail.py and make_variants.py now reject empty --title with a clear error instead of producing a textless thumbnail; compose_thumbnail.py catches PIL.UnidentifiedImageError on corrupt input and prints a clean message instead of leaking a traceback; pick_frames.py returns exit 2 (not 0) on ffprobe failure or zero-duration video so scripted pipelines work correctly; pick_frames.py now falls back to 3 evenly-spaced samples on very short clips and adds --relax-on-empty for one retry with loose thresholds; removed a redundant double-ffprobe call. No breaking changes — all v0.1.0 CLI flags and output filenames are unchanged.
